note: Focused on English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese providers; unknown language metadata is kept for manual review. Torrentio is excluded because Limitless is intended to remain HTTPS/direct-stream focused when P2P is disabled. AnikotoTV is pinned to the Asura Synthesis implementation. Cineby and AnimeKai remain pinned to their confirmed-working Limitless native implementations. AniZone is intentionally reset to Yoru's untouched upstream provider as a clean diagnostic baseline; no Limitless AniZone code should be selected while upstream behavior is being tested.
